text:
Maya: Quick sync — I'm sketching a phased v1 sunset. idea: user-affinity gating + console opt-in for v2, then progressive ramp. leaving this here for feedback before I draft the runbook.

Raj: +1 for server-side affinity. client headers are noisy. prefer sticky routing based on account_id -> affinity shard.

Sasha: Telemetry needs: current v1 active accounts, daily tokens by account, v2 acceptance rate, fallback rate (v2->v1), and error classes. we should add a synthetic probe to measure latency delta at p50/p95.

Oliver: Quotas question — v2 has slightly different token accounting when using streaming. we need a mapping table and a migration multiplier so customers don't accidentally blow past reserved capacity. suggest 0.95 multiplier for first 2 weeks.

Lina (PM): Customer comms: 6 week public notice + in-console banner with opt-in toggle. enterprise customers get contact from AE and a dedicated migration window. Banner text should include a 'preview v2' CTA.

Eva: Proposed ramp schedule (canary -> global): week0: 0.5% random accounts (telemetry only), week1: 5% with sticky affinity, week2: 20% (roll quota mult), week3: 50% + console opt-in nudge, week4: 100% with soft-fallback enabled for 48h.

Maya: Implementation notes: need a console flag to override routing per-account, and an operator toggle to pause rollout. also we should expose telemetry in dashboard per-route and per-model.

Raj: For implementation, header fallback still useful for devs. let's support both: server-affinity default, header override if `x-rw-client-version: 2` present. snippet below for router check.

```
# pseudocode in router
if X-Override-Version == 2:
  route = v2
elif account in affinity_shard(v2_shard_set):
  route = v2
else:
  route = v1
```

Sasha: Sampling probes: capture 1-in-200 requests for deep logs (response diffs) and 1-in-20 for perf metrics. store diffs for 7 days. create alert if semantic-fallbacks > 0.5% for two consecutive days. :eyes:

Oliver: For quotas: add temporary quota-mapping in billing pipeline: `v1_tokens * 0.95 -> v2_units` toggleable per-account. also include a console view highlighting accounts where projected usage > commit.

Lina (PM): UX: add a per-account migration card in Console -> Deployments showing current route, opt-in toggle, migration metrics (acceptance, errors, token delta).

Eva: Rollback policy: autoswitch-back if errors > 3% for 5m or latency delta p95 > 2x baseline. ops-bot — can we automate that?

ops-bot: runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v1-sunset-gating (created by ops-bot). auto-rollback rule added to staging: errors>3%/5m.

deploy-bot: Canary started — 0.5% accounts moved to v2 affinity shard: shard_id=alpha-3. rollout_id=rs-2026-0319-1. logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rs-2026-0319-1

Maya: Next steps: Sasha to add telemetry dashboards & alerts, Raj + Eng to wire server affinity + header override, Oliver to add quota-mapping, Lina to draft banner copy, Eva to author runbook states. I'll assemble PR with config names. aim to start canary on Monday.

Raj: ack, I'll pair with Maya on the router flag naming. prefer `routing.v2_affinity_shards` and `override.header_version`.

Sasha: I'll add dashboard panels: `v2_accept_rate`, `v2_fallback_rate`, `v2_error_rate`, `v2_p95_latency_delta`. will also add an eval job to run example prompts and record diffs nightly.

Lina (PM): I'll put draft banner copy in the docs repo and ping #marketing for comms schedule.

Maya: thanks all. leaving this thread open for any objections or edge cases we missed. :thumbsup:
